text.description_html:
Emtek S30003RNK, Modern Stainless Steel Round Knobset with Square Rose

Made by Emtek, the S30003RNK Round Knob with Square Rose is made out of stainless steel and has a brushed stainless steel finish. Choose from dummy, passage, or privacy functions for 1-3/8 inch to 2-3/4 inch thick doors with either a 2-3/8 inch or a 2-3/4 inch backset. This Modern Stainless Steel Round Knobset with Square Rose is easy to install and will look awesome in any contemporary setting. The square rosette allows for this modern material knob and rose set to look great in all contemporary decors.

Features of the Satin Stainless Round Knob with Square Rose:

  • Fits standard door cut outs (2-1/8" pre-drilled doors).
  • Knob is surface mounted (rosette screws to the door's face).
  • Solid stainless steel knob and trim rose.
  • Sold as complete set.
  • Easy to install.

Specifications of the Contemporary Stainless Steel Round Knobset with Square Rosette:

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Knob Diameter: 2-1/4"
  • Knob Projection: 2-11/16"
  • Stem: 1"
  • Rose Length: 2-1/2" square
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/8 - 2-3/4"
  • Backset: 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"

Available Functions:

  • Double Dummy: No door latch. Door knobs on both sides of the door. Package Includes: 2 knobs, 2 roses, and mounting screws.
  • Passage (Hall or Closet): For doors that don't need locking. Latch operates from either side of door. Package Includes: 2 knobs, 2 roses, door latch, strike plate, dust box, faceplate, spindle, and mounting screws.
  • Privacy (Bedroom or Bathroom): For doors that could need privacy locking. Latch operates from either side. Push button on interior rose engages privacy; emergency release hole is on exterior rose. Turning inside knob will release privacy push button and retract the door latch. Package Includes: 2 knobs, 2 roses, privacy button, door latch, strike plate, dust box, faceplate, spindle, and mounting screws.

Sold Individually
